subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous set of generic runtime objects covering HUD character-grid rendering and guarded render dispatch, float-to-ARGB gradient encoding, a zero-initializable state struct, UI effect trigger helpers, session-state flags, a singly-linked append list and a fixed-block pool with two linked lists, a mode-switch float accumulator with a three-target animation dispatcher, championship score-threshold lookup, a packed vehicle-orientation bitfield codec, config-line serialization, a 176-byte-stride circular buffer with index checks, thin this+0x0 delegation forwarders, and player-file / render post lifecycle hooks. The strongest cross-function groupings are the packed orientation field (this+0xF bitfield plus int16 components at +0xC/+0xE/+0x10), the stride-176 circular buffer (this+0x9B0 base, +0x9B4 modulus, +0x9B8/+0x9BC indices), and the shared 12-byte linked-list node record (data/+0, next/+4, flag/+8). All owner classes here are GUESS syntheses; the packet labels every function owner UNKNOWN.

summary: Reconstruction of generic runtime objects from 32 validated function IR records. The packet supplies no DERIVED owner classes; every owner is UNKNOWN, so all classes below are GUESS-level proposals. The packed vehicle-orientation state is the strongest grouping: five functions (0x004B2B90, 0x004B2BF0, 0x004B2C20, 0x004B2C50, 0x004B31A0) share the this+0xF dword as a bitfield (2-bit class in bits[1:0], 6-bit scaled value in bits[7:2]) alongside int16 components at +0xC/+0xE/+0x10, and are called by VehicleOrientationFromEulerAngles (0x004B2DD0), sub_4B32A0 (0x004B32A0) and VectorToShort3Conversion (0x004B2C80). The stride-176 circular buffer groups 0x004B6920/0x004B69A0/0x004B69F0 over this+0x9B0/0x9B4/0x9B8/0x9BC, consumed by pit-stall and pitstop callers. Config-line serialization groups 0x004B1B10/0x004B1C80/0x004B1E20 on the shared this+0xC key/this+0x14 value layout with common separator/terminator globals and the 0x00566C30 length-checked writer. The three thin forwarders 0x004B9870/0x004B9880/0x004B9CD0 share only the deref-this+0x0-and-forward shape (synthetic grouping, flagged). The 12-byte linked-list node record (data/+0, next/+4, flag/+8) is shared between the append list (0x004A1DC0) and the fixed-block pool (0x004B44E0/0x004B45F0). Game_Post (0x0042DA30) drives two post-lifecycle hooks (0x004B1900, 0x004B4170) that both use the StringSplitLoop source-path assertion plus DebugLogWrite pattern. Read-only float globals flagged by packet facts but absent from the raw decompilation (compiled-in literals) are deferred to unresolved_evidence_refs.

function_roles.role: Batch-renders eleven single characters at fixed 2-row grid positions. Guards on the format context at this+0xC, the display context at this+0x14, and the non-zero sub-field at display+84; formats each of eleven character-source globals (dword_7CE6AC..dword_7CE8A4, each plus a small per-slot offset) as '%c' via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck (0x0058815F) into a local buffer, then places each character at a fixed (x,row) coordinate through the render-placement helper 0x00553070. Row 0 holds seven characters at x=0..210 (y=11); row 1 holds five at x=20..188 (y=65). Returns the result of the final placement call.

Guarded rendering dispatch. When the render-surface pointer at this+0x8 and the display-context pointer at this+0x14 are both non-null, reads the sub-context pointer at this+0x68 (*(this+0x14 + 84)) and, if also non-null, calls 0x0049F1C0 with fixed flags (1, 1, 0) plus the two guarded pointers. Any null check aborts the dispatch. Invoked by sub_49D5D0 (0x0049D5D0).

Pure float-to-ARGB gradient encoder. Clamps the input into 30.0..150.0 and selects one of three channel branches (blue below 70.0, green mid-range, red at/above 110.0), computing the channel via CRTFtol (0x00587BDC) and combining with the ARGB mask constants (0xFF0000FF, 0xFFFF0000, 0xFFFFFF00).

State-struct zero-initializer: writes 0 to the 19 consecutive dword fields this+0x0..0x48 (4-byte stride) and returns the original this pointer. No reads, no callees, no globals. Invoked by MultiCallSequence (0x0049AFE0) as part of a state-setup sequence.

Stores parameter a2 into this+0x1C, then invokes UISparkleEffect (0x0049ED30) and returns its result. Used by ParamRangeClampedLerp (0x0049F530) to commit a computed value before triggering the sparkle effect.

Guard-then-forward: if the dword at this+0x0 is non-zero, calls the raw-source helper sub_553700(a2) and returns its result; otherwise falls through with an uninitialized result register. Invoked by ParamRangeClampedLerp (0x0049F530).

Conditional dispatch: if the int flag at this+0x4 is non-zero, calls the raw-source helper sub_553700 with a2 and returns its result; when zero, falls through returning an uninitialized local. Invoked by ParamRangeClampedLerp (0x0049F530).
Sets the global byte byte_7CE25E (0x007CE25E) to 1. A single race-state flag write with no arguments, guards, or side effects beyond the one global store.

Appends a node containing data a2 to a singly-linked list (head this+0x0, tail this+0x4, first-node anchor this+0x8, count this+0xC), gated by the enabled flag byte at this+0x10 and a2 non-null. Allocates a 12-byte node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (0x00587C03), initializes data/+0, next/+4, flag/+8, links at the tail (setting head/anchor/tail on the first insert), and increments the count. Returns the new node pointer, or 0 when guarded out or allocation fails.

Per-frame accumulator update gated on the mode word at this+0x78: mode 0 skips, mode 1 resets the accumulator float at this+0x84 to 0, any other non-zero mode adds argument a2 to it. After the update the accumulator value is forwarded to the raw-source sub_4A2840 for further processing. Invoked from ThreeTargetAnimationDispatcher (0x004A55A0).

Per-frame dispatcher that forwards to up to three sub-object pointers held in this: calls 0x004A3570 on the objects at this+0x10 and this+0xC passing a3, and calls AccumulatorWithStateSwitch (0x004A4050) on the object at this+0x14 passing a2. Each call is independently null-guarded.

Linear search over up to three stride-2 championship score thresholds starting at this+0x164 (entry count at this+0x160, hard cap 3). Each stride-2 entry qualifies when its value is greater than the player score at *this+0x403C and lower than the total-race-laps global dword_8ACF8C. Returns the first qualifying entry via this[2*v2+89], or -1 when none qualifies. Invoked by ShortComputation_c8a0 (0x0049C8A0).

Straight-line constructor for a seven-dword object: installs the vtable pointer off_5ACC14 at this+0x0 and initializes +0x4 (0), +0x8 (-1 sentinel), +0xC (0), +0x10 (89), +0x14 (0), +0x18 (89). Returns this. No branches, no calls.

Player-file post-processing invoked by Game_Post (0x0042DA30). When StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_20, 2515) (0x004D7A50) returns non-zero, writes the debug message aEnteredPlayerf_2 into dword_8AD25C via DebugLogWrite (0x004D7AA0). Runs player-data init sub_4B0770(this, 1). When the state field at this+0x1F78 is not 4, runs the raw-source additional setup sub_4B17B0(this); otherwise returns the sub_4B0770 result.

Formats and writes a debug log entry into the output buffer a2. Copies the label string from this+0x14 into a 256-byte local via FormattedStringCopy (0x004A1A60), writes the separator aSS_6 (0x005CD13C), conditionally appends a comment taken from this+0x0C (falling back to byte_5EA438 when null, skipped when empty) via aS_8 (0x005D23A8), then writes the suffix token word_5C30B4. All writes use the length-checked writer 0x00566C30. Returns 0.

Serializes one config key/value pair into the output buffer a2. Formats the value field at this+0x14 (float) into a 256-byte scratch via ArithmeticComparison (0x004A1B20), writes the key prefix aSS_6, conditionally writes the key name from this+0xC (defaulting to byte_5EA438 when null) via aS_8, and terminates with word_5C30B4. Returns 0.

Writes one config key/value pair into the output buffer a2. Formats the value field at this+0x14 (float) into a 256-byte scratch via StringFormatCopyWithFloat (0x004A1A00), writes the key prefix aSS_6, conditionally writes the key name from this+0xC (defaulting to byte_5EA438 when null) via aS_8, and terminates with word_5C30B4. Returns 0.

Classifies float a2 into one of four 2-bit categories written into bits[1:0] of the dword at this+0xF (mask 0xFFFFFFFC). Ranges: a2<=0.75 -> 0, (0.75, 0.85000002) -> 1, [0.85000002, 0.94999999) -> 2, >=0.94999999 -> 3. Called by VectorToShort3Conversion (0x004B2C80).

Selector that reads the 2-bit classification field at this+0xF, masks with 3, and returns one of four blend constants: 0 -> 0.69999999, 1 -> 0.80000001, 2 -> 0.89999998, 3 -> 1.0. Called by VehicleOrientationFromEulerAngles (0x004B2DD0) and sub_4B32A0 (0x004B32A0).

Encodes a float argument into a 6-bit field of the byte at this+0x0F: scaled by ~0.0180018 (packed constant referenced by global 0x005ACCE0), truncated by CRTFtol (0x00587BDC), masked to 6 bits, shifted left 2, and XOR-merged into bits[7:2] with mask 0xFFFFFF03, preserving bits[1:0]. Stores the merged word back and returns it. Called by VectorToShort3Conversion (0x004B2C80).

Decodes the 6-bit field from the dword at this+0xF: shift right 2, mask 0x3F, multiply by the 55.549999 scale held in flt_5ACCE4, and return the product as double. Consumed by VehicleOrientationFromEulerAngles (0x004B2DD0) and sub_4B32A0 (0x004B32A0).

Converts three float inputs a2[0..2] into int16 values at this+0xC, this+0xE and this+0x10 using a 2048.0 scale with saturation at +/-15.999512 (0x7FFF / -32767 clamps). Returns the third converted value. Caller VehicleOrientationFromEulerAngles (0x004B2DD0) suggests the packed int16 values encode an orientation derived from Euler angles.

Post-render lifecycle marker. Runs StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_21, 438) (0x004D7A50); when the byte result is non-zero writes 'Entered Render Post' into dword_8AD25C via DebugLogWrite (0x004D7AA0) and returns that result, otherwise returns the zero result. Invoked by Game_Post (0x0042DA30) as part of shutdown/cleanup sequencing.

One-time initialization of a fixed-block pool and its two linked lists. Zeroes the eight pool globals dword_8AB6F0..dword_8AB70C, allocates a 4-byte root node plus a 13824-byte buffer via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (0x00587C03), builds one 12-byte active-list head node (flag byte 1) linked through dword_8AB6F0/8AB6F4/8AB6F8/8AB6FC, then in 32 iterations of 432 bytes creates one 12-byte free-list node (flag byte 0) per sub-block, linking front-first through dword_8AB700/8AB704/8AB708 and counting in dword_8AB70C. Returns the last allocation result.

Tears down the fixed-block pool, guarded by byte_8AB6E0 bit 0 (set on entry to prevent double-free). Walks the free list (head dword_8AB700) and the active list (head dword_8AB6F0), freeing each node's buffer pointer via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) when the in-use flag byte at node+8 is set, then frees the node struct. Resets all free-list and active-list globals to zero. Returns 1 on both paths.
Returns base + 176 * a2 where base is the pointer stored at this+0x9B0: the address of the a2-th element of a 176-byte-stride array. Caller is PitStallProximityCheck (0x004B5DA0).

Advances a circular write index: reads the buffer base at this+0x9B0, computes (index at this+0x9B8 + 1) modulo the modulus at this+0x9B4, stores the new index, and calls the raw-source PhysicsObjectListManager on the entry at base + 176 * new_index. Caller is PitstopActionSet (0x004B6940).

Returns TRUE when either this[622] (0x9B8) or this[623] (0x9BC) is negative, i.e. when either index field is in the invalid/uninitialized state; FALSE only when both are >= 0. Called by CircularBufferCheck (0x004B68C0) and PitstopActionSet (0x004B6940).

Thin forwarding wrapper: dereferences the pointer at this+0x0, passes it as the first argument to the raw-source PitTimingUpdate along with a2/a3/a4, and returns the helper's char result unchanged. Callers are ConditionalStateUpdate (0x004BA150) and TwoPathDispatch (0x004BA6C0).

Thin forwarder: dereferences the pointer stored at this+0x0, passes it to the raw-source sub_4B7DE0, and returns that call's char result. The prelabel getter template is structurally inaccurate; the actual behavior is a delegation. Invoked by GuardedDispatchWithStateCheck (0x004BA740).

Thin void forwarder: reads the int stored at this+0x0 and calls the raw-source AngleClampWrap(*this, a2) with the field value and the incoming float a2. Callers sub_4B9890 and FloatAccumulator (0x004B9D00) feed time/accumulator values, consistent with an angle/time clamp application.

Loads the target struct pointer from this+8, writes the byte argument a2 into its field at offset 0xF80, and returns the intermediate pointer. Unconditional write; the field is likely a per-object flag or state byte set by AIBehaviorInitialization (0x004BF0A0).

classes.name: HudCharacterGridRenderer
classes.responsibility: HUD text renderer that formats eleven global character sources as '%c' and places each at a fixed 2-row grid position. Gates rendering on a format context pointer at this+0xC, a display context pointer at this+0x14, and a non-zero sub-field at display+84. The HUD indicator interpretation is DERIVED prose only.

classes.name: HudRenderDispatchController
classes.responsibility: Guarded rendering dispatch controller: requires a render-surface pointer at this+0x8, a display-context pointer at this+0x14, and a sub-context pointer at this+0x68 (loaded as *(display+84)) before calling 0x0049F1C0 with fixed flags (1, 1, 0). Invoked by sub_49D5D0.

classes.name: ARGBGradientEncoder
classes.responsibility: Free float-to-ARGB gradient encoder mapping 30.0..150.0 through blue/green/red channel branches computed with CRTFtol (0x00587BDC). Whether the caller consumes a full ARGB color or a single channel is unverified.

classes.name: StateZeroInitStruct
classes.responsibility: State struct with a 76-byte zeroed footprint (19 dwords, offsets 0x0..0x48). 0x0049E8F0 writes 0 to every field and returns this; invoked by MultiCallSequence (0x0049AFE0) during a state-setup sequence. Concrete type and semantics unknown.

classes.name: UIParamEffectTrigger
classes.responsibility: Small __thiscall helpers invoked by ParamRangeClampedLerp (0x0049F530): 0x0049ED00 commits a parameter into this+0x1C then triggers UISparkleEffect (0x0049ED30); 0x0049ED10 and 0x0049ED20 are guard-then-forward helpers keyed on this+0x0 and this+0x4 that delegate to the raw-source sub_553700. The grouping is a GUESS synthesis based on the shared caller; the three methods use overlapping field regions.

classes.name: SessionStateFlagSetter
classes.responsibility: Session-subsystem flag writer that sets the global byte byte_7CE25E to 1. No object state is touched; the flag's meaning is not evidenced by this packet.

classes.name: LinkedListNodeRecord
classes.responsibility: 12-byte singly-linked list node record established by the append operation of 0x004A1DC0 and the pool node wiring of 0x004B44E0/0x004B45F0: data pointer at +0, next pointer at +4, flag byte at +8. Only the next-pointer field has a packet evidence ref; the data/flag offsets come from the raw source. The payload type is unknown.

classes.name: AppendLinkedList
classes.responsibility: Singly-linked list container with head at this+0x0, tail at this+0x4, a first-node anchor at this+0x8, element count at this+0xC and an enabled flag byte at this+0x10. 0x004A1DC0 appends a 12-byte node holding data a2, linking at the tail and setting head/anchor/tail together on the first insert.

classes.name: ModeSwitchFloatAccumulator
classes.responsibility: Accumulator object gated by a mode word at this+0x78 (0 = disabled, 1 = reset, other = accumulate) operating on the float at this+0x84. After the per-frame update the accumulator value is forwarded to the raw-source sub_4A2840. Invoked from the three-target dispatcher.

classes.name: ThreeTargetAnimationDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Per-frame dispatcher holding three sub-object pointers (this+0x10 and this+0xC targeted by 0x004A3570 with a3, this+0x14 targeted by the accumulator 0x004A4050 with a2). Each call is independently null-guarded. The animation interpretation is DERIVED prose; the owner and sub-object identities are unknown.

classes.name: ChampionshipScoreTable
classes.responsibility: Championship score-threshold table: stride-2 entries starting at this+0x164 (up to 3, count at this+0x160). An entry qualifies when above the player score at *this+0x403C and below the total-race-laps global dword_8ACF8C; the lookup returns this[2*v2+89] or -1. The player-score owner object is unidentified.

classes.name: SevenDwordVTableObject
classes.responsibility: Seven-dword object constructed by 0x004A8B50: installs the vtable off_5ACC14 at this+0x0 and initializes +0x4 (0), +0x8 (-1 sentinel), +0xC (0), +0x10 (89), +0x14 (0), +0x18 (89). The meaning of the 89 values and the -1 sentinel is unconfirmed.

classes.name: PlayerFileRecord
classes.responsibility: Player-file record processed by Game_Post (0x0042DA30): the post routine runs player-data init sub_4B0770(this, 1) and branches on the state field at this+0x1F78, taking an additional raw-source setup (sub_4B17B0) when the state is not 4. State value 4 as a ready/completed marker is DERIVED prose, not proven here.

classes.name: ConfigLineSerializer
classes.responsibility: Config/debug line serializer writing into an output buffer a2. Shared layout: key/name pointer at this+0xC (fallback default byte_5EA438 when null) and a value/label field at this+0x14 (float for the two config writers, string source for the log-line formatter). All three write the separator aSS_6 (0x005CD13C), the conditional name/label via aS_8 (0x005D23A8) and terminate with word_5C30B4 through the length-checked writer 0x00566C30. In 0x004B1C80 and 0x004B1E20 the formatted value buffer is never written to a2 in the visible body.

classes.name: OrientationPackedField
classes.responsibility: Packed vehicle-orientation state: the dword at this+0xF holds a 2-bit class in bits[1:0] and a 6-bit scaled value in bits[7:2], alongside int16 components at this+0xC/+0xE/+0x10. Encoders/decoders/selectors are 0x004B2B90 (classify), 0x004B2BF0 (blend select), 0x004B2C20 (6-bit encode), 0x004B2C50 (6-bit decode) and 0x004B31A0 (3-float to int16 pack), consumed by VehicleOrientationFromEulerAngles (0x004B2DD0), sub_4B32A0 (0x004B32A0) and VectorToShort3Conversion (0x004B2C80). The grouping is a GUESS synthesis from the shared field region and caller set; physical meaning of the packed values is unknown.

classes.name: RenderPostLifecycleMarker
classes.responsibility: Post-render lifecycle marker invoked by Game_Post (0x0042DA30): runs the StringSplitLoop source-path assertion (2, aDDevF119992002_21, 438) and, on non-zero, writes the 'Entered Render Post' debug message into dword_8AD25C. The literals 2 and 438 carry no established semantics.

classes.name: FixedBlockPool
classes.responsibility: Global fixed-block pool (state in dword_8AB6F0..dword_8AB70C) with two linked lists: an active list (head dword_8AB6F0, tail dword_8AB6F4, anchor dword_8AB6F8, count dword_8AB6FC, head flag byte 1) and a free list (head dword_8AB700, anchors dword_8AB704/8AB708, count dword_8AB70C, head flag byte 0), built over a 13824-byte buffer carved into 32 x 432-byte sub-blocks. 0x004B44E0 initializes, 0x004B45F0 tears down under the byte_8AB6E0 bit-0 re-entry guard. The pool consumer is unknown.

classes.name: Stride176CircularBuffer
classes.responsibility: Circular/array buffer with base pointer at this+0x9B0, element modulus at this+0x9B4, write index at this+0x9B8 and read index at this+0x9BC, element stride 176 bytes. 0x004B6920 resolves an element by index, 0x004B69A0 advances the write index modulo the modulus, 0x004B69F0 reports invalid state when either index is negative. Consumed by pit-stall/pitstop callers (0x004B5DA0, 0x004B68C0, 0x004B6940). The 176-byte element type is unknown.

classes.name: PointerFieldForwarder
classes.responsibility: Thin __thiscall delegation wrappers that dereference the pointer/int stored at this+0x0 and forward it (plus unchanged arguments) to a raw-source helper: PitTimingUpdate (0x004B9870), sub_4B7DE0 (0x004B9880), AngleClampWrap (0x004B9CD0). The grouping is a GUESS synthesis from the shared deref-this+0x0 shape only; the three callees and their semantics are distinct and unverified.

classes.name: AIBehaviorFieldAccessor
classes.responsibility: Accessor into an AI-behavior data struct: loads the target struct pointer from this+8 and writes a byte argument to its field at offset 0xF80 (the packet encodes that nested offset as this+0xF80). Invoked by AIBehaviorInitialization (0x004BF0A0); the enum values written are unknown.

state_machines.name: AccumulatorModeSwitch
states: mode0_disabled (mode word at this+0x78 == 0: no accumulator update, no forward call)
mode1_reset (mode word == 1: accumulator at this+0x84 set to 0)
mode_other_accumulate (any other non-zero mode: accumulator at this+0x84 set to previous + a2)
state_machines.transitions: The mode word at this+0x78 selects the path on every per-frame invocation; after any active update the accumulator value at this+0x84 is forwarded to the raw-source sub_4A2840. The packet gives no evidence of how the mode word itself changes.

state_machines.name: FixedBlockPoolLifecycle
states: initialized (root node + 13824-byte buffer allocated, active and free lists wired through dword_8AB6F0..dword_8AB70C)
torn_down (list heads/counts reset to zero, byte_8AB6E0 bit 0 latched)
state_machines.transitions: 0x004B44E0 moves uninitialized -> initialized. 0x004B45F0 moves initialized -> torn_down; the byte_8AB6E0 bit-0 guard latches on first teardown so a re-entry skips the walk (double-free protection).

interfaces.name: GamePostDebugLifecycleHook
interfaces.purpose: Post-update lifecycle hooks driven by Game_Post (0x0042DA30): each runs a StringSplitLoop source-path assertion (literal count differing per hook) and, on a non-zero result, writes a debug message into the shared dword_8AD25C via DebugLogWrite (0x004D7AA0). 0x004B1900 additionally runs player-data init and a state branch; 0x004B4170 returns the assertion result.

interfaces.name: OrientationPackedFieldCodec
interfaces.purpose: Encode/decode/select operations over the packed orientation state at this+0xF: 0x004B2B90 classifies a float into the 2-bit bits[1:0] field, 0x004B2BF0 reads that field back as a blend constant, 0x004B2C20/0x004B2C50 encode/decode the 6-bit bits[7:2] value, and 0x004B31A0 packs three floats into the int16 components at +0xC/+0xE/+0x10. Consumers are VehicleOrientationFromEulerAngles (0x004B2DD0), sub_4B32A0 (0x004B32A0) and VectorToShort3Conversion (0x004B2C80).

interfaces.name: HudDisplayContextRenderer
interfaces.purpose: HUD rendering over a shared display-context pattern: both the batch character renderer (0x0049E170) and the conditional render dispatch (0x0049E3E0) gate on a display-context pointer at this+0x14 and on the non-null sub-context at display+84, then drive a render helper (0x00553070 placement / 0x0049F1C0 dispatch). Whether both belong to one owning object is not proven.

compatibility_contracts.name: PackedOrientationStateLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The dword at this+0xF is a packed bitfield: bits[1:0] hold a 2-bit class (written with mask 0xFFFFFFFC, values 0..3), bits[7:2] hold a 6-bit scaled value (written with mask 0xFFFFFF03). The int16 components at this+0xC, +0xE and +0x10 hold float inputs scaled by 2048.0 and saturated at +/-15.999512 (0x7FFF / -32767). Encode scale ~0.0180018 (0x005ACCE0), decode scale 55.549999 (0x005ACCE4), integer conversion via CRTFtol (0x00587BDC).

compatibility_contracts.name: Stride176BufferContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The object holds an array base pointer at this+0x9B0 with per-element stride 176 bytes, an element-count/modulus at this+0x9B4, a write index at this+0x9B8 and a read index at this+0x9BC. Element access is base + 176 * index; the write index advances as (index + 1) modulo the modulus. A negative write or read index marks the buffer invalid (TRUE from 0x004B69F0).

compatibility_contracts.name: AppendLinkedListContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The append list keeps head at this+0x0, tail at this+0x4, a first-node anchor at this+0x8, element count at this+0xC and an enabled flag byte at this+0x10. Nodes are 12-byte records (data at +0, next link at +4, flag byte at +8) allocated via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (0x00587C03). The first insert sets head/anchor/tail to the new node and count to 1; subsequent appends link the old tail's +4 slot to the new node and increment the count.

compatibility_contracts.name: FixedBlockPoolContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The global pool state (dword_8AB6F0..dword_8AB70C) must be zeroed on init; a 13824-byte buffer is carved into 32 sub-blocks of 432 bytes, each covered by a 12-byte free-list node (flag byte 0) wired front-first through dword_8AB700/8AB704/8AB708/8AB70C, while one active-list head node (flag byte 1) is wired through dword_8AB6F0/8AB6F4/8AB6F8/8AB6FC. Teardown is re-entry guarded by byte_8AB6E0 bit 0 and frees node buffers through FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) only when the node in-use flag byte at +8 is set, then resets the list globals.

compatibility_contracts.name: ChampionshipThresholdLookupContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Championship score-threshold lookup: stride-2 entries begin at this+0x164 (entry count at this+0x160, hard cap of 3). A threshold entry qualifies when it is greater than the player score at *this+0x403C and lower than the total-race-laps global dword_8ACF8C. The first qualifying entry is returned via this[2*v2+89]; -1 when no entry qualifies or the cap is reached.

compatibility_contracts.name: PlayerFilePostContract
